title: rover_localization Software Requirements Specification
scope: rover_localization is a configuration-and-launch package (no own source code) that runs robot_localization filters for the rover. In the default mode it starts rover_ekf_node, which fuses wheel-odometry body velocities and IMU yaw rate into the continuous odom -> base_footprint estimate. With GPS fusion enabled (ROVER_SYSTEM_USE_GPS) it also starts rover_ekf_global_node (map-frame filter adding GPS X/Y), rover_navsat_transform_node and rover_gps_heading_node (package rover_gps_heading). The GPS driver itself belongs to the sensor payload (rover_sensors, outside this boundary).

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall run a robot_localization EKF node named rover_ekf_node whenever the launch argument use_ekf is true.
requirements.rationale: A fused odometry estimate is needed by navigation and control above the wheel odometry of SYS-SR-003.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 launch rover_localization rover_localization.launch.py use_ekf:=True` shows node <ns>/rover_ekf_node in `ros2 node list`; with use_ekf:=False (the default) no EKF node is started.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall configure rover_ekf_node to run at 50.0 Hz in 2D mode (two_d_mode true) with a sensor timeout of 0.1 s.
requirements.rationale: A 50 Hz fused estimate matches the drive control rate of SYS-SR-002 and gives local planners fresh odometry.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 topic hz <ns>/odom` over 60 s with wheel odometry and IMU present reports >= 47.5 Hz (50 Hz -5 %); z, roll and pitch of the published pose stay 0.
requirements.comments: No automated test in the package.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall fuse only the body linear velocities vx and vy from nav_msgs/Odometry on odometry/wheels into rover_ekf_node, not the wheel-odometry pose.
requirements.rationale: Wheel-odometry X/Y is integrated along the drive controller's own (skid-biased) yaw and would conflict with the IMU heading; vy = 0 acts as a nonholonomic constraint.
requirements.acceptance: odom0 = odometry/wheels and odom0_config has true only at the vx and vy positions in both shipped configs.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall fuse only the yaw rate (vyaw) from sensor_msgs/Imu on imu/data into rover_ekf_node, not the IMU absolute orientation or linear acceleration.
requirements.rationale: Absolute IMU orientation is magnetometer-influenced near the drive motors; the driver's linear acceleration includes gravity.
requirements.acceptance: imu0 = imu/data and imu0_config has true only at the vyaw position in both shipped configs.
requirements.comments: SYS-SR-019's orientation and acceleration outputs are therefore not used by localization.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall publish the rover_ekf_node estimate as nav_msgs/Odometry on the relative topic odom (remapped from odometry/filtered).
requirements.rationale: odom is the fused odometry consumed by navigation, rover_gps_heading and the UI.
requirements.acceptance: With use_ekf:=True, `ros2 topic info <ns>/odom` shows publisher rover_ekf_node, type nav_msgs/msg/Odometry, frame_id odom and child_frame_id base_footprint (namespace-prefixed when a namespace is set).

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall make rover_ekf_node the only broadcaster of the odom -> base_footprint transform, using world_frame odom, odom_frame odom, map_frame map and base_link_frame base_footprint, with the namespace as tf_prefix.
requirements.rationale: REP-105 requires a single continuous odom -> base chain; the drive controller's own odom TF is disabled so the EKF owns it.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 run tf2_ros tf2_echo odom base_footprint` shows updates from rover_ekf_node only; the drive controller config has enable_odom_tf false.
requirements.comments: Doc drift: README.md:9 and :32 say odom -> base_link, but the configs use base_footprint (REP-120 footprint; base_footprint -> base_link comes from the URDF, rover_description/urdf/rover_a1/base.urdf.xacro:18-23). Frame chain map/odom/base_footprint/base_link is REP-105 compatible.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall expose the robot_localization services of rover_ekf_node as localization/set_pose, localization/enable and localization/toggle.
requirements.rationale: Allows the operator or navigation to re-initialise and pause the filter.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 service list` shows <ns>/localization/set_pose, <ns>/localization/enable and <ns>/localization/toggle served by rover_ekf_node.
requirements.derived_rationale: Technical operability interface of the filter.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall enable print_diagnostics on every EKF and remap all localization nodes' /diagnostics to the namespaced diagnostics topic.
requirements.rationale: With print_diagnostics false, robot_localization reports a permanent false ERROR ('No events recorded') for the odometry/filtered frequency status; namespacing lets the aggregator group them under Localization.
requirements.acceptance: With use_ekf:=True and inputs present, <ns>/diagnostics carries rover_ekf_node statuses at OK level, and diagnostics_agg shows them under /Rover/Localization.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall, when fuse_gps (default $ROVER_SYSTEM_USE_GPS) is one of true/1/yes/on in any case and use_ekf is true, additionally start rover_ekf_global_node, rover_navsat_transform_node and rover_gps_heading_node and load the _with_gps configuration.
requirements.rationale: Optional absolute positioning for outdoor operation without changing the continuous odom frame.
requirements.acceptance: With ROVER_SYSTEM_USE_GPS=true and use_ekf:=True, `ros2 node list` contains the three additional nodes; with ROVER_SYSTEM_USE_GPS unset only rover_ekf_node runs.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall configure rover_ekf_global_node at 50.0 Hz in 2D mode with world_frame map, fusing the same wheel vx/vy and IMU yaw rate as rover_ekf_node plus X/Y only from odometry/gps, and publish its estimate on odometry/global.
requirements.rationale: Dual-EKF scheme: GPS corrections appear only in map -> odom, keeping odom continuous for local control.
requirements.acceptance: In GPS mode `ros2 topic hz <ns>/odometry/global` reports >= 47.5 Hz and its frame_id is map; odom1_config has true only at X and Y.
requirements.comments: Until rover_gps_heading has aligned (gps/heading_imu), navsat_transform has no transform and the global filter runs on wheels + IMU only (rel_localization_with_gps.yaml:6-9).

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall broadcast map -> odom from rover_ekf_global_node only when publish_global_tf (default $ROVER_SYSTEM_GPS_MAP_TF) is one of true/1/yes/on, overriding the config's publish_tf.
requirements.rationale: Only one node may own map -> odom; by default AMCL or SLAM owns it.
requirements.acceptance: In GPS mode with the variable unset, tf2_monitor shows no map -> odom from rover_ekf_global_node while odometry/global is still published; with ROVER_SYSTEM_GPS_MAP_TF=true it does.
requirements.comments: Nothing prevents AMCL/SLAM and ROVER_SYSTEM_GPS_MAP_TF=true running together; README only warns.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall run rover_navsat_transform_node at 10.0 Hz with a 3.0 s start delay, magnetic_declination_radians 0.0, yaw_offset 0.0 and zero_altitude true, subscribing gps/fix, gps/heading_imu and odometry/global and publishing odometry/gps and gps/filtered, with the datum service at localization/datum.
requirements.rationale: Converts the GNSS fix into the map frame; the heading already arrives in ENU from rover_gps_heading, so no declination or IMU mounting offset applies.
requirements.acceptance: In GPS mode, once gps/heading_imu is published, <ns>/odometry/gps is published at <= 10 Hz and <ns>/localization/datum is available.
requirements.comments: Known limitation: navsat_transform computes its transform once from the first heading; after gps/reset_heading_alignment the node must be restarted (README.md:115-116).

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall pass to rover_gps_heading_node publish_heading true, heading_frame_id <namespace>/base_link, min_heading_std_rad 0.05 and the alignment parameters min_segment_length_m 3.0, min_speed_m_s 0.3, max_yaw_rate_rad_s 0.1, max_yaw_change_rad 0.1, max_horizontal_std_m 5.0, max_fix_gap_s 2.5, max_odometry_age_s 0.5, required_segments 3 and max_offset_std_rad 0.1.
requirements.rationale: The alignment tuning lives with the localization config that consumes the heading.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 param get <ns>/rover_gps_heading_node alignment.min_segment_length_m` returns 3.0 (and likewise for the other values) in GPS mode.
requirements.derived_rationale: Technical configuration of the heading-alignment helper used by the GPS localization chain.
requirements.comments: heading_frame_id is base_link while the EKFs use base_footprint; harmless for yaw but inconsistent [TBC].

requirements.text: The rover_localization launch file shall accept the arguments use_ekf (default False), fuse_gps, publish_global_tf, namespace (default $ROVER_SYSTEM_NAMESPACE), localization_mode (rel|enu, default rel), localization_config_path, common_dir_path (default empty), use_sim (default False, sets use_sim_time) and log_level (default INFO).
requirements.rationale: Single entry point used by rover_bringup and rover_gazebo.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 launch rover_localization rover_localization.launch.py --show-args` lists these arguments with these defaults.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall ship a valid configuration file for every value accepted by the localization_mode argument, including enu.
requirements.rationale: An accepted launch argument must not lead to a missing-file start failure.
requirements.acceptance: `ros2 launch rover_localization rover_localization.launch.py use_ekf:=True localization_mode:=enu` (with and without fuse_gps) starts all nodes without a parameter-file error.
requirements.derived_rationale: Technical consistency of the launch interface; either add enu_localization[_with_gps].yaml or remove 'enu' from the choices.
requirements.comments: Only rel_localization.yaml and rel_localization_with_gps.yaml exist in config/; localization_mode:=enu resolves to enu_localization*.yaml, which is missing.

requirements.text: The rover_localization shall have an automated test that verifies the EKF publishes odom at >= 47.5 Hz and the odom -> base_footprint transform from recorded or simulated wheel-odometry and IMU input.
requirements.rationale: The package currently has no tests, so frame, rate and fusion configuration regressions (SYS-SR-003, SYS-SR-021) go undetected.
requirements.acceptance: A launch_testing test in rover_localization/test passes under `colcon test --packages-select rover_localization`, checking odom rate and TF frames.
requirements.comments: CMakeLists.txt only installs config and launch; no BUILD_TESTING block and no test/ directory.
